parts.part: The gap is EXACTLY these three; all other headline inputs are in Git
parts.notes: The source report itself caveats that for ENVGATE-02 (row 5) the committed RESULTS.json lists positives only, and completeness (no other positive establishment) rests on block files on M2 (envgate2 runs/ is gitignored). Same completeness caveat applies to the BEE numerators. Aether E-006 72 unit files are on M2 (headline re-executed from Git, so recomputable). Aphrodite A17 inputs are in Git but only on 4 unmerged seat branches, not main. So 'all other headline inputs are in Git' holds at R-13's headline-grading level but is overstated as 'exactly'.

notes: The three named gaps are correct and match R-13 lines 59-61 and 137-138 (Bash/git was denied, so branch-only files could not be inspected; main-tree checks via Glob/Grep). The exclusivity/'all other inputs in Git' part is contradicted by R-13's own limit 2 (ENVGATE-02 positive-list completeness depends on M2 block files), and Aphrodite evidence is branch-only. R-34 REPORT.md is unrelated (lens-field study).
